abu-bakr-first-caliph.research_focus: Saqifah of the Banu Sa'ida in Medina, the gathering of the Prophet's companions choosing a successor, seventh-century Arabian dress
abu-bakr-first-caliph.scene: In a shaded courtyard in Medina, a circle of robed men sit on rugs, one elder with a white beard clasping the hand of an older companion in pledge, palm trunks and mud-brick walls behind them

rashidun-victory-nahavand.research_focus: Nahavand in the Zagros mountains, Arab cavalry and infantry against a Sasanian army with armoured horsemen, 642
rashidun-victory-nahavand.scene: Arab horsemen with round shields and long spears pour down a rocky Zagros valley toward Sasanian lancers in scale armour, a fallen Persian banner trampled in the dust

battle-of-the-camel-caliph-ali.research_focus: the plain outside Basra, 656, a litter-bearing camel ringed by defenders in the thick of fighting, seventh-century Arab arms
battle-of-the-camel-caliph-ali.scene: On a dusty plain outside a palm-fringed city, warriors in mail and turbans clash around a large camel, its covered litter bristling with arrows, as fighters ring it in a tight defence

great-mosque-damascus-begun.research_focus: the Umayyad construction of the Great Mosque of Damascus on the former basilica of St John, mosaic workers, columns and capitals reused
great-mosque-damascus-begun.scene: Masons and mosaic workers swarm over scaffolding inside a vast colonnaded Roman-era enclosure, setting golden glass tesserae into a half-finished wall as a robed caliph watches from a ladder's foot

samarra-founded-by-mutasim.research_focus: Samarra on the Tigris, the new Abbasid palace city, Turkish guard cavalry, the spiral minaret outline of the Great Mosque rising
samarra-founded-by-mutasim.scene: Beside the broad Tigris, soldiers in tall caps and tunics drill on horseback before the long mud-brick walls of a new palace under construction, a tall spiralling tower rising behind them

cordoba-caliphate-proclaimed.research_focus: Abd al-Rahman III in Cordoba, tenth-century Andalusian court, horseshoe arches, formal proclamation of the caliph's title
cordoba-caliphate-proclaimed.scene: In a columned hall of red-and-white horseshoe arches, a richly robed ruler stands on a dais as officials in turbans bow and a herald reads from a scroll to a packed court

madinat-al-zahra-begun.research_focus: construction of Madinat al-Zahra on the slope of the Sierra Morena above Cordoba, terraced palace city, ashlar stonework and imported marble
madinat-al-zahra-begun.scene: On a terraced hillside above a river valley, labourers drag cut stone and marble columns up ramps toward half-built palace walls, rows of horseshoe arches already standing on the upper terrace

buyids-seize-baghdad.research_focus: Buyid Daylamite troops entering tenth-century Baghdad, the Round City and the Tigris, a seated Abbasid caliph in the palace reduced to a figurehead
buyids-seize-baghdad.scene: Soldiers in felt caps and mail stream through a gate of a walled river city while, inside the palace hall, a robed caliph sits on a throne with a stern armed commander standing close beside him

saladin-ends-fatimid-caliphate.research_focus: Saladin in Cairo in 1171, the Fatimid palace and a mosque minbar, the Friday sermon changed to the Abbasid name, Ayyubid soldiers
saladin-ends-fatimid-caliphate.scene: In a crowded Cairo mosque, a preacher on a stepped wooden pulpit addresses rows of kneeling men while a lean commander in a simple turban and mail stands at the back, black Abbasid banners being unfurled by the doorway

khilafat-movement-india.research_focus: Khilafat Movement mass meetings in India, 1919-20, crowds in kurtas and caps, hand-lettered banners, a mosque-side rally ground
khilafat-movement-india.scene: A vast crowd of men in caps and long shirts packs an open ground beside a domed mosque, hand-painted cloth banners raised above their heads and a speaker addressing them from a low wooden platform
